payload.comment: Ingestion stage evidence is internally consistent and complete. Split sizes (train=89996, val=10004, test=7180) match the official PathMNIST partition exactly, subsampled=false confirms full-dataset usage, and both archive_md5 and per-split selected_index_sha256 hashes are present for provenance. The test-domain note (CRC-VAL-HE-7K, different clinical center) is properly documented and is a known characteristic of PathMNIST rather than a defect. Code SHA256, package versions, and deterministic_torch=true are all recorded. One minor observation: llm_model_digest is null for the qwen3.8 Ollama model, meaning the exact model weights are not pinned by hash. This does not affect data ingestion integrity but will be a reproducibility gap if the LLM is invoked in later stages. No deterministic findings were raised. No omitted artifacts. Proceed to the next stage.
llm_issues: llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama); exact model weights are not pinned by a content hash, which limits full reproducibility of any LLM-dependent downstream step.
